# Infinite Words and $In(\alpha)$

This notebook explores **ultimately periodic** $\omega$-words. These are infinite words of the form $\alpha = u \cdot v^\omega$, where $u$ is a finite prefix called the *stem*, and $v$ is a finite word called the *period* that repeats infinitely often.

We also compute $In(\alpha)$, which is the set of symbols from the alphabet that appear **infinitely often** in the word $\alpha$. For an ultimately periodic word, $In(\alpha)$ is exactly the set of symbols present in the period $v$.

The running example is an editor that is opened once and then remains active.
For instance,
$\texttt{open}\cdot(\texttt{edit}\ \texttt{save})^\omega$ describes an
execution in which editing and saving both recur. The one-time
`open` belongs to the stem and therefore does not belong to $In(\alpha)$.

---

## Widget 1: $\omega$-Word Explorer

Enter a stem $u$ and a period $v$ (comma or space-separated symbols, e.g.,
`open`, `edit`, `save`). The word strip below will visualize the infinite word
$\alpha = u \cdot v^\omega$.

  <div class="sc-explain" id="nb11-explain">
    Showing the word &alpha; = <code>open</code> &middot; (<code>edit save</code>)<sup>&omega;</sup>
  </div>

  <div class="sc-panel">
    <h4>&omega;-Word Strip &alpha;(0, 23)</h4>
    <div class="legend-row">
      <div class="legend-item"><div class="legend-color" style="background:#888;"></div> Stem part</div>
      <div class="legend-item"><div class="legend-color" style="background:#2ec4b6;"></div> Period part</div>
    </div>
    <div class="word-strip" id="nb11-strip"></div>
    
    <h4 style="margin-top: 20px;">Infinitely Often Symbols: In(&alpha;)</h4>
    <div class="in-alpha-box" id="nb11-in-alpha"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function() {
  const colors = ['#2b9af3', '#f97316', '#22c55e', '#a855f7', '#ec4899', '#eab308', '#0ea5e9', '#ef4444'];
  const symbolColorMap = {};
  let colorIdx = 0;

  function getColor(sym) {
    if (!symbolColorMap[sym]) {
      symbolColorMap[sym] = colors[colorIdx % colors.length];
      colorIdx++;
    }
    return symbolColorMap[sym];
  }

  function parseInput(str) {
    return str.trim().split(/[\s,]+/).filter(s => s.length > 0);
  }

  function render() {
    const uStr = document.getElementById('nb11-u').value;
    const vStr = document.getElementById('nb11-v').value;
    
    let u = parseInput(uStr);
    let v = parseInput(vStr);
    
    if (v.length === 0) {
      v = ['?']; // Fallback period if empty
    }

    const explainEl = document.getElementById('nb11-explain');
    explainEl.innerHTML = `Showing the word &alpha; = <code>${u.join(' ')}</code> &middot; (<code>${v.join(' ')}</code>)<sup>&omega;</sup>`;

    const stripEl = document.getElementById('nb11-strip');
    stripEl.innerHTML = '';

    const totalBoxes = 24;
    for (let i = 0; i < totalBoxes; i++) {
      let sym = '';
      let isStem = false;
      if (i < u.length) {
        sym = u[i];
        isStem = true;
      } else {
        sym = v[(i - u.length) % v.length];
      }

      const box = document.createElement('div');
      box.className = 'word-box';
      
      const charDiv = document.createElement('div');
      charDiv.className = 'word-char';
      charDiv.textContent = sym;
      charDiv.style.background = getColor(sym);
      charDiv.style.opacity = isStem ? '0.6' : '1';
      
      const idxDiv = document.createElement('div');
      idxDiv.className = 'word-index';
      idxDiv.textContent = i;
      
      box.appendChild(charDiv);
      box.appendChild(idxDiv);
      stripEl.appendChild(box);

      // Add separator between stem and period, and between periods
      if (i === u.length - 1 || (i >= u.length && (i - u.length + 1) % v.length === 0)) {
        if (i < totalBoxes - 1) {
          const sep = document.createElement('div');
          sep.className = 'word-separator';
          if (i === u.length - 1) {
            sep.style.background = '#050401';
            sep.style.width = '3px';
          }
          stripEl.appendChild(sep);
        }
      }
    }

    // Calculate In(alpha)
    const inAlphaSet = new Set(v);
    const inAlphaArray = Array.from(inAlphaSet);
    
    const inAlphaEl = document.getElementById('nb11-in-alpha');
    if (inAlphaArray.length === 1 && inAlphaArray[0] === '?') {
        inAlphaEl.innerHTML = `In(&alpha;) = &empty; <em>(invalid period)</em>`;
    } else {
        const setStr = inAlphaArray.map(s => `<span style="color:${getColor(s)}">${s}</span>`).join(', ');
        inAlphaEl.innerHTML = `In(&alpha;) = { ${setStr} }`;
    }
  }

  document.getElementById('nb11-update').addEventListener('click', render);
  // Auto-render on enter
  document.getElementById('nb11-u').addEventListener('keyup', (e) => { if(e.key==='Enter') render(); });
  document.getElementById('nb11-v').addEventListener('keyup', (e) => { if(e.key==='Enter') render(); });
  
  // Initial render
  render();
})();
</script>
